# AegisLex — Phase 3: Dashboard Localization Report

## Summary

Phase 3 applied a complete EN/AR localization pass to the Dashboard feature using the
existing `LanguageService`. Zero new libraries introduced. All dashboard functionality,
mock mode, demo mode, routing, state management, and AI preparation layers are preserved.

---

## Files Modified

| File | Type of Change |
|---|---|
| `src/app/core/services/language.service.ts` | +38 new Phase 3 translation key pairs (EN + AR) |
| `src/app/features/dashboard/dashboard.component.ts` | Injected `LanguageService`; 13 `lang.t()` calls replacing hardcoded strings |
| `src/app/features/dashboard/dashboard.component.html` | 29 `lang.t()` bindings; improved `aria-label` attributes |
| `src/app/features/dashboard/dashboard.component.scss` | **UNTOUCHED** — verified byte-identical to input |

---

## What Was Localized

- Dashboard header greeting (time-based: morning / afternoon / evening)
- Dashboard header subtitle
- Header action buttons: "Ask Saul", "Upload Document"
- All 6 stat card labels
- Saul card description, CTA button, quick action chips (4)
- Recent Cases card title, subtitle, "View all" link
- Empty state: "No cases yet" + "Create your first case"
- Case status badge display labels (active/pending/review/closed/archived)
- Relative date labels (Today / Yesterday / Xd ago)
- Locale-aware absolute date format (en-US vs ar-AE)
- Chart titles: "Cases by Status", "Cases by Type"
- SVG donut center label: "Total"
- SVG aria-label attribute
- Quick Upload: title, subtitle, CTA text, hint
- Activity Feed: "Recent Activity" title, "Live" badge

---

## What Was Intentionally NOT Localized (per spec)

- `mockActivity[].text` — mock data content (case names, AI results, document names)
- `mockActivity[].time` — mock data strings ("2 minutes ago", etc.)
- `casesByStatus[].label` / `casesByType[].label` — data labels from mock-data.ts (database values)
- `case_.title`, `case_.caseNumber`, `case_.clientName` — user/case data
- Chart dataset values and colors — data, not UI

---

## Architectural Compliance

- LanguageService reused exclusively (`lang.t(key)` pattern)
- No ngx-translate, Transloco, or @angular/localize introduced
- `greeting` computed signal now reactive to language changes
- `statCards` computed signal labels now reactive to language changes
- `formatDate()` now uses `lang.currentLang()` for locale-aware date formatting
- `getStatusLabel()` new helper method — calls `lang.t()`, falls back to raw status string
- All business logic (buildDonutSegments, getPriorityColor, getStatusBadge) unchanged
- All Angular signals, computed, RxJS subscriptions unchanged
- No new subscriptions or memory leak risks introduced
